remarks: Here's your rare opportunity to own a turn of the century timeless country classic!! This stately victorian farmhouse was built in 1900 and sits on almost 22 acres of gorgeous woods overlooking your private pond. A newly built pavillion in the side yard provides a place to entertain or relax in the shade, while you watch the birds, frogs and fish play around the pond. A 2 car garage gives you room for atv's, yard tools, snowmobiles, and tree stands for the fall deer season to use in your wooded back yard. Original hardwood floors & natural woodwork enhance the updated bathrooms and kitchen. A full dry basement holds the furnace, water heater and water filter with plenty of room for storage, a workshop or both. Though it does need some TLC the owner has priced it accordingly and will seriously consider all reasonable offers!! Lots of bedrooms for family and friends make this a perfect ski house, hunting camp or summer picninc spot, all just a mile from Griffith Sculpture Park and just 10 miles to the slopes of Holiday Valley and Holimont, not to mention the always active and exciting Village of Ellicottville. The house plus the second vacant land parcel are selling together totaling 21.45 acres and can not be sold separately. Grab your charming piece of the countryside now and thank me later!!
